description: Submit the verification code the user received. On success the session is stored so restarts resume without signing in again, until it lapses.

code.description: The code the USER received. Never guess or generate it.

rememberDevice.description: Record the portal's device-trust token. NOTE: this portal does not redeem it, so it does not skip future verification; the persisted session is what carries over.
